New Hampshire requires applicants who are sixteen or seventeen to complete an approved driver-education program before applying for a license. Approved driver education includes thirty classroom hours taught by a certified instructor. The driver-education course also requires ten hours of behind-the-wheel instruction with a certified driving instructor. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. Preserve who the statement covers, the action it describes and any exception it states.

lines.text: A certified instructor must provide six hours of driving observation as part of the driver-education
requirements.

narration.text: A certified instructor must provide six hours of driving observation as part of the driver-education requirements. Additional supervised practice totals forty hours with a parent, guardian or another responsible adult; at least ten of those hours occur at night. After moving to New Hampshire, a new resident has sixty days to obtain the state's driver license. When applying in New Hampshire, a new resident must give up every valid license issued by another jurisdiction. An applicant whose driving privilege is suspended or revoked elsewhere must obtain reinstatement before New Hampshire will accept the application. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. Preserve who the statement covers, the action it describes and any exception it states.

New Hampshire does not issue a permit for learning to drive; the manual instead describes a supervised-practice exception. An unlicensed learner aged at least fifteen and a half may practice with a parent, legal guardian or responsible adult who is at least twenty-five and is a licensed driver. Applicants for an operator noncommercial license must pass vision, knowledge and road testing. The stated visual-acuity requirement is twenty-forty in both eyes, or twenty-thirty when the applicant sees through only one eye. When corrective lenses are needed to pass vision screening, restriction B requires those glasses or contacts during driving. After failing vision screening, an applicant needs an eye examination with a doctor's recommendation before completing further license testing. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. Preserve who the statement covers, the action it describes and any exception it states.
